inspected_anchors.finding: Repository title, description and historical presentation only.
Default pytest excludes integration/LLM/LaTeX categories; tests are declared, not absent.
Pinned requirements coexist with unpinned huggingface-hub; not a complete environment lock.
Main execution path reaches Judge.forward.
Reachable quality_judge passes ts=False; fixed_pairs=[] permits later LLM edits; KCI/cycle steps follow.
Judge.forward reaches quality_judge.
IID row branch; temporal block_size10 and block starts sampled without replacement.
High/low thresholds and low directed entries included in middle_prob_edges.
Middle ordered entries combined and deduplicated as unordered pairs.
Accepted A/B responses direct an edge; accepted C creates a forbid entry.
Edge tags, receiver/source convention, default sample=False and asymmetric-tag requirement.
Default helper consults true_graph when orienting ambiguous predicted edge tags.
Default helper invocation and minimum-SHD selection; sampling mode also selects against truth.
Ordered off-diagonal binary metrics; autoregressive diagonals omitted.
Default GraphEvaluator construction.
Benchmark replaces missing values with zero; this is a preprocessing choice.
Timer covers Programming.forward; temporal branch uses direct binary scoring, tabular branch compute_metrics.
Declared benchmark configuration is source context, not proof of executed experiments.
Inspect full prompt: A/B direction, C no relationship and D unknown remain distinct.
Wrapper invocation, optional correlated-feature removal/restoration and returned lag-matrix storage.
User selection bypasses filtering; otherwise LLM selects candidates at temperature0.
Prompt uses query, statistics, knowledge, resources and requested CPDAG/DAG output.
accept_CPDAG=True and boot_num=20 defaults.
Distinct raw/revised/lagged fields do not alone establish semantic compatibility.

supported_claims: Default tabular benchmark compute_metrics invokes a truth-assisted orientation helper; sampling mode also chooses against truth. This concerns evaluation, not observed live-discovery truth leakage.
The selected main/Judge call path passes ts=False despite an available temporal block branch.
Low ordered reverse entries can return a high-confidence unordered pair to the LLM; fixed_pairs=[] does not enforce the paper no-override promise.
A conditional accepted C response can erase the stipulated high-confidence edge before later KCI/cycle operations.
User-selected algorithms bypass filtering; a DAG preference does not supply identifying orientation evidence.
Lag matrices can be retained when returned, but summary scoring and state fields alone do not establish temporal semantics.
Default tests exclude three marked categories, and at least one requirement is unpinned; no absence-of-tests claim.
limitations: Author review of paper and static historical source only; no downloaded code, model, paid engine or bank workflow executed.
The2026-05-15 source snapshot is not established as the2025 paper experiment code.
Conditional witnesses stipulate inputs and accepted responses; they do not observe an upstream failure or source experiment.
Root MIT and one vendored MIT notice do not close all dependency, asset, data, provider or deployment rights.

inspected_anchors.finding: Title, thirteen authors, exact arXiv v2 date and code repository identity.
Natural-language objective/constraint parsing and user revisions; preprocessing scope.
Diagnostics and filtering are author-described workflow components, not certificates of causal assumptions.
Ranking, configuration, execution-error revision and bootstrap edge confidence.
Explicit no-override claim for high-confidence bootstrap decisions; PDF report generation.
Web interface is author-described; no present deployment trial established.
Section5.2 explicitly generates synthetic scenarios with known ground truth.
Table2 default/sparse countercomparisons; simulated financial scenario50 nodes/three domains, F1 .650 plus/minus .130.
Linear stationary temporal Table3; default .673 vs .695/.733; n5000 table .668 but prose .649; very-large table p100 but prose p1000.
Conclusion describes automated selection/configuration/execution; proposed future extensions.
Temporal simulation is stationary linear; preliminary design settings are scoped.
Runtime cap20min; best-DAG conversion for tabular graphs; temporal summary-graph evaluation and excluded diagonals.

supported_claims: The described pipeline separates natural-language interaction, preparation, selection, execution, graph refinement and reporting.
Paper p7 explicitly states LLM suggestions cannot override high-confidence bootstrap decisions.
Table2 includes default/sparse countercomparisons; the financial scenario is generated, not bank validation.
Table3 is linear stationary and does not establish universal superiority; its p100/p1000 and .668/.649 discrepancies are retained.
AppendixD reports best-DAG conversion and temporal summary-graph metrics excluding diagonals; no lag-specific or autoregressive qualification follows.
